name: @aholbreich/pi-tl
description: Pi extension for the tl (task-ledger) CLI.

scripts.version: node -e "const b=require('node:child_process').execSync('git branch --show-current',{encoding:'utf8'}).trim();if(b!=='main'){console.error('Must be on main branch to version. Current: '+b);process.exit(1);}const s=require('node:child_process').execSync('git status --porcelain',{encoding:'utf8'}).trim();if(s){console.error('Working tree not clean. Commit or stash changes first.');process.exit(1);}"
